## Claims
- [source-backed] The source identifies \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) as the ideal of \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) generated by \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2, lines 1365-1375]
- [proved] In the integral box-Schur/Pieri presentation, for \(p=c=1\), \(q=i+1\), \(r=j+1\), \(d=ij\), and \(\min(i,j)=3\),
  \[
  M_{d+4}=\bigoplus_{\substack{i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i+1)^{j+1}\\|\mu|=d+4}}\mathbb Zs_\mu,
  \qquad
  (A_+M)_{d+4}=\sum_{\ell=1}^{4}h_\ell M_{d+4-\ell}.
  \]
  The requested target is established, subject to that ambient integral presentation.

## Strategy
Put
\[
P_{x,y}:=s_{((i+1)^x,i^{\,j-x},y)},
\]
omitting a zero final part.  The Schur span of all partitions in the interval
\([i^j,(i+1)^{j+1}]\) is an ideal: every Littlewood--Richardson summand
of \(s_\lambda s_\mu\) contains \(\mu\), hence contains \(i^j\).
Together with the source-backed generating description, this gives the
displayed direct-sum interval presentation of \(M\).

Set
\[
C_x=P_{x,4-x},\qquad
\max(0,4-i)\le x\le\min(4,j).
\]
These are exactly the degree-\(d+4\) interval partitions.  Explicitly,
their indices are
\[
\{1,2,3\}\ (i=j=3),\qquad
\{1,2,3,4\}\ (i=3<j),\qquad
\{0,1,2,3\}\ (j=3<i).
\]
Indeed, a degree-four enlargement has \(x\) added boxes in the new
rightmost column and \(4-x\) boxes in the new bottom row.  The exceptional
possibility of a bottom row of length \(i+1\) has excess at least
\(i+j+1>4\), so does not occur.

For \(u+v=4-\ell\le3\), Pieri gives
\[
h_\ell P_{u,v}=C_u+C_{u+1},
\]
where an unavailable \(C_x\) means \(0\).  The ten complete
generator-Pieri rows are therefore
\[
\begin{array}{rcl}
h_4P_{0,0}&=&C_0+C_1,\\
h_3P_{0,1}&=&C_0+C_1,\qquad h_3P_{1,0}=C_1+C_2,\\
h_2P_{0,2}&=&C_0+C_1,\qquad h_2P_{1,1}=C_1+C_2,\qquad
h_2P_{2,0}=C_2+C_3,\\
h_1P_{0,3}&=&C_0+C_1,\qquad h_1P_{1,2}=C_1+C_2,\qquad
h_1P_{2,1}=C_2+C_3,\qquad h_1P_{3,0}=C_3+C_4.
\end{array}
\]
They are complete because \(M_{d+k}\) for \(0\le k\le3\) has basis
\(\{P_{u,k-u}:0\le u\le k\}\), and a horizontal strip from such a
partition to degree \(d+4\) can change the right-column count only from
\(u\) to \(u\) or \(u+1\).

Finally, \(A_+=(h_1,\ldots,h_q)\), with \(q=i+1\ge4\).  If \(am\) is a
homogeneous product of total degree \(d+4\), write
\[
a=\sum_{\ell=1}^{q}h_\ell a_\ell.
\]
Since \(M\) has no degree below \(d\), terms with \(\ell>4\) vanish after
multiplication by \(m\).  Hence
\[
am\in\sum_{\ell=1}^4h_\ell M_{d+4-\ell}.
\]
The reverse containment is immediate from \(h_\ell\in A_+\).  Expanding
the lower-degree factors in their \(P_{u,v}\)-bases reduces every such
product to the ten listed rows.
